decisions.reason: Launched only a year ago with its own page and a natural fit in the drainage family, so its value is still uncertain and keeping it costs little.
Floor-level shower drainage is the firm's core strategic direction, so this early-stage option is cheap to hold and worth keeping open.
As the flagship design product with its own page, it is a focal option whose uncertainty has not resolved and which merits further commitment.
The integrated-slope shower element fits the low-profile, accessible direction, and one year of mentions shows no failure, so the option stays open.
The backflow basement drain is a specifically developed, named product with its own page in a durable safety niche, so dropping it this early is unjustified.
The air-admittance valve is a low-cost complementary component, and the evidence so far does not show its value is unlikely to be realized.
